entries.text: The S-1 filing reveals that each of its seven co-founders plans to sell 3,378,378 shares.

The company has set an initial price range of $70 to $78 per share.
At the midrange of $74, each founder would receive just shy of $250 million.
At the low end of $70, they would take in just over $236 million, while the high end of $78 yields just under $264 million.
Board members Reed Hastings and Christopher Liddell have also indicated interest in buying shares.
The seven founders left OpenAI in 2021 to start Anthropic, citing disagreements over AI safety.
After the sale, each will own about 3.2% of Class A shares.
Collectively, they will control 51.1% of the votes through supervoting rights, ensuring they remain in control of the company despite other holders like Amazon and Google.
